question: By whose agency and will was the yoginī named Icchā transmitted up to māyā?
premises: The siddhas are involved in transmission
The scope reaches up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to māyā through supreme will
uncertainties: The exact verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to māyā by supreme will.
